notification.title: Notifications
notification.description: Things waiting for you and changes to your account show up here. Read notifications are removed after the retention period.

message.webhookDisabled_one: Webhook "{{name}}" failed {{count}} time in a row and was turned off
message.webhookDisabled_other: Webhook "{{name}}" failed {{count}} times in a row and was turned off

event.description: The system notifies the people involved when these events happen. Turning a channel off stops future deliveries; notifications already sent are kept, and turning it back on does not resend them.
event.mandatory: Security related, cannot be turned off

approvalPending.name: Request awaiting review
approvalPending.description: Notifies reviewers when someone submits a request (account registration, folder access).
approvalPending.recipients: People holding the “Review requests” permission at submission (excluding the requester)

approvalResult.name: Request reviewed
approvalResult.description: Notifies the requester when a request is approved or rejected. Email is the existing review result email.

userRolesChanged.name: Roles changed
userRolesChanged.description: Notifies a user when roles are assigned to or removed from them.

webhookDisabled.name: Webhook turned off
webhookDisabled.description: Sent when a webhook is turned off after failing to deliver too many times in a row.
webhookDisabled.recipients: Everyone who can edit webhooks at that moment

announcementPublished.name: Announcements
announcementPublished.description: Announcements sent by admins, now or on a schedule. Open the notification to read the full text.

preference.title: Notifications
preference.description: Choose which notifications you receive. Items turned off or required by your administrator cannot be changed.

lock.mandatory: Security related, cannot be turned off

overview.title: Notification overview
overview.description: In-app notifications received by everyone in this tenant. Content is shown as the recipient sees it; read notifications past the retention period are removed automatically.
